snippet.title: Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass | Extended Trailer
snippet.description: Take a deep breath and unwind as we dive deep with an extended look at the underwater town of Bubbly Basin. The Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass paid DLC Part 1: Bubbly Basin releases on August 5, 2026.
